title: The Unicorn Pools
cheer: Pop! A unicorn is free at {spot}!
opening: Evil magic is zapping the Unicorn Pools! The unicorns are hiding inside magic bubbles to stay safe. Break the evil spells with your fairy light and set every unicorn free!
not_yet: Zzzap! The evil magic is too strong there right now. Follow the clue!

steps.clue: Where lily pads float and little frogs say hi, a unicorn hides from the stormy sky. Find the Lily Pool and break the spell!
Twinkle, twinkle, shining bright, a unicorn hides in the Starlight Pool tonight. Wave your wand to set it free!
Silver and quiet, round as the moon, the Moonlight Pool needs rescuing soon! A little unicorn waits for you.
Fizz and sparkle, bubble and pop! The Sparkle Pool's unicorn is scared of the storm on top. Zap the evil magic away!
Up to the top where the Crystal Spring flows, the biggest storm of evil magic glows. One giant zap to save them all!

ending: BOOM! The evil magic is gone! The bubbles float away, a rainbow fills the sky, and all the unicorns prance and splash. The unicorns name you the Hero of the Unicorn Pools!
